def price_elasticity(data):
    data["% Change in Demand"] = data["unitlistprice"].pct_change()
    data["% Change in Price"] = data["qty"].pct_change()
    data["Price Elasticity"] = data["% Change in Demand"] / data["% Change in Price"]
    return np.mean(data["Price Elasticity"])


df_price_elasticity=df.groupby(['part','unitlistprice'])['qty'].sum().reset_index()
df_price_elasticity_2=df_price_elasticity.groupby('part').apply(lambda x:price_elasticity(x))

#清理 unitlistprice 的outlier
print("Shape of The Before Outliers:",df.shape)
n = 1.5 #清除1.5倍的outlier
# IQR = Q3-Q1
IQR = np.percentile(df['unitlistprice'], 75) - np.percentile(df['unitlistprice'], 25)
# outlier = Q3 + n*IQR
df = df[df['unitlistprice'] < np.percentile(df['unitlistprice'], 75) + n * IQR]
# outlier = Q1 - n*IQR
df = df[df['unitlistprice'] > np.percentile(df['unitlistprice'], 25) - n * IQR]
# 清完看看
print ("Shape of The After Outliers: ", df.shape)

'''
切割資料
test data using ymd
'''
#新增一欄partrk，把相同part分組排序
df_move['partrk'] = df_move.groupby('part')['ymd'].rank(method='first',ascending=False)


#挑選part rank=1的以確保test data裡面含有所有part都至少有一個
#挑出1963個列當成test data

#挑出 202209月以前的資料當training data, 202209當testing data, 驗證模型實際跑出來的值與本月的差距

'''
Original XGBoost Model
Setting : GPU_1 -> Using Nvidia GEforce MX250 GPU
'''

def get_xgb_model(params):
    # comment the next 2 lines out if you don't have gpu
    #params['gpu_id'] = 0
    #params['tree_method'] = 'gpu_hist'
    params['seed'] = 13

    gbm = xgb.XGBRegressor(**params) #n_estimators=500
    model = gbm.fit(x_train, y_train,
                    verbose=False,
                    eval_set = [[x_train, y_train],
                              [x_valid, y_valid]],
                    #eval_metric='mlogloss',
                    early_stopping_rounds=15)
    return model
In [157]:
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
'''
設定 Evaluation Metric
'''
def xgb_objective(params):
    params['max_depth']=int(params['max_depth'])
    params['n_estimators']=int(params['n_estimators'])
    #params['early_stopping_rounds']=15
    model = get_xgb_model(params)
    xgb_test_proba = model.predict(x_valid)
    #xgb_test_proba.astype('int')
    #score = brier_score_loss(y_valid, xgb_test_proba)
    score = mean_squared_error(y_valid, xgb_test_proba)
    return(score)



trials = Trials() # recorder for our results
In [158]:
'''
Fmin : Hyperopt 裡面的Function, 找出對應的Evaluation Metic最小的參數
'''
def get_xgbparams(space, evals=15):
    params = fmin(xgb_objective,
        space=space,
        algo=tpe.suggest,
        max_evals=evals,# trials=trials
       )
    params['max_depth']=int(params['max_depth'])
    params['n_estimators']=int(params['n_estimators'])
    return params
